label: Generic cross-service nuclear assessment
scope: baseline governance, assurance, routing, and residual floors that should not silently inherit every specialist gate
risk_if_misclassified: generic floors become the dumping ground for every nuclear gate and reproduce the rev0305 crossproduct problem

label: Emergency preparedness, EPZ, public warning, evacuation, KI, medical response, and recovery
scope: onsite/offsite emergency plans, EPZs, alerts, protective actions, population monitoring, exercises, and recovery
default_gate_treatment: apply emergency-specific gates plus selected radiological/health and climate-access gates
risk_if_misclassified: the cube can claim reasonable assurance while missing the operational path from alert to evacuation, monitoring, reentry, and compensation

label: Radiological monitoring, dose, public health, environmental media, and public dashboards
scope: effluent, environmental sampling, dose pathways, lab QA, public dashboards, health registry, monitoring counterevidence
default_gate_treatment: apply radiological-monitoring gates and emergency links only where protective action or health follow-up depends on monitoring
risk_if_misclassified: monitoring evidence becomes a vague comfort signal instead of a decision-quality input

label: Cyber, digital I&C, OT/IT, software, cloud, AI, vendor access, and telecom dependencies
scope: digital assets, security program, remote access, SBOM, vulnerability governance, logging, cyber incident recovery, AI boundaries
default_gate_treatment: apply cyber/digital gates to digitalized nuclear assets and dependency interfaces, not to unrelated public-value rows
risk_if_misclassified: sensitive cyber controls either disappear or sprawl into irrelevant records

label: Physical security, safeguards, access authorization, material security, and transport security
scope: protected areas, design basis threat, armed response, insider mitigation, material access areas, safeguards and sensitive publication controls
default_gate_treatment: apply security/safeguards gates only where security-relevant assets, material, access, or route controls are in scope
risk_if_misclassified: publication, routing, and security tests become either over-redacted or absent

label: Climate, site, water, thermal, external hazard, blackout, and extreme-weather resilience
scope: site hazard reanalysis, flood, drought, heat, smoke, ultimate heat sink, blackout, multi-unit/common-cause, climate access and adaptation CAPEX
default_gate_treatment: apply climate/site/water gates to siting, operations, and offsite response interfaces where hazards affect protective capability
risk_if_misclassified: the model can pass a site under yesterday’s climate and infrastructure assumptions

label: Fuel cycle, HALEU, spent fuel, backend, waste, decommissioning interface, and material provenance
scope: uranium supply after mining, conversion, enrichment, fabrication, fuel qualification, spent fuel, dry cask, repositories, recycling decisions
default_gate_treatment: apply fuel/backend gates only to fuel, backend, and waste pathways plus related safety/security interfaces
risk_if_misclassified: fuel and waste constraints become a generic caveat instead of a gating delivery dependency

label: Uranium mining, milling, tailings, reclamation, Indigenous consent, and upstream environmental controls
scope: upstream extraction, mine EIA, tailings, water, radon, worker radiation protection, reclamation bonds, FPIC, postclosure stewardship
default_gate_treatment: apply upstream gates only to mining/milling/tailings/provenance rows
risk_if_misclassified: upstream harms are either buried in fuel supply or inappropriately applied to reactor operations

label: Fleet operations, maintenance, outage, performance, configuration, and safe restart
scope: capacity factor, oversight indicators, refueling, maintenance, spares, configuration, operating experience, load following, safe restart
default_gate_treatment: apply operations gates to operating or restartable fleet assets, not to all policy benefit claims
risk_if_misclassified: operability evidence is confused with system-benefit narrative

label: Finance, construction, buildability, procurement, supply chain, and project delivery
scope: capital stack, bankability, cost/schedule baseline, reference design, long-lead components, factory modules, open-book economics, project risk allocation
default_gate_treatment: apply delivery and finance gates to project-delivery pathways and ratepayer/taxpayer exposure rows
risk_if_misclassified: build failures are hidden behind nuclear-positive policy preference

label: Sector coupling, industrial heat, hydrogen, desalination, data centers, critical loads, and coproduct dispatch
scope: non-electric nuclear uses, heat markets, desalination, brine, hydrogen/ammonia, data centers, large loads, thermal storage, dispatch priority
default_gate_treatment: apply coproduct/interface gates where nuclear output is tied to a non-grid service or critical load
risk_if_misclassified: co-benefit claims evade load, water, safety, and public-value tests

label: System benefit, public value, displacement, emissions, air quality, reliability, and anti-greenwash counterfactuals
scope: avoided emissions, fossil displacement, ELCC, reliability, land/material intensity, air quality, public health, anti-greenwash and portfolio comparisons
default_gate_treatment: apply benefit/counterfactual gates to claimed climate/public-value benefits, not to operational readiness by default
risk_if_misclassified: benefit claims and safety/readiness evidence become mutually substitutable

label: Workforce, regulator capacity, training, public docket capacity, quality culture, and institutional readiness
scope: construction craft, operator licensing, regulator staffing, emergency planning workforce, health physics, quality culture, human performance, succession
default_gate_treatment: apply capacity gates where human, regulatory, training, or institutional capacity is the limiting constraint
risk_if_misclassified: plans assume staff and institutional competence that do not exist

label: Liability, insurance, compensation, recovery finance, claims, cleanup funding, and long-term stewardship finance
scope: financial protection, retrospective premiums, incident claims, public-health/recovery funds, decontamination/cleanup assurance, ratepayer/taxpayer backstops
default_gate_treatment: apply liability/recovery gates to public-risk-transfer and recovery pathways, with emergency recovery links where people need documentation and aid
risk_if_misclassified: protective action succeeds but people are stranded after relocation, cleanup, or claims failures

label: Geopolitics, export finance, sanctions, 123 agreements, nonproliferation, vendor lock-in, and allied supply resilience
scope: diplomacy, sanctions exposure, foreign ownership, export control, safeguards reporting, allied reserves, anti-coercion, spares continuity
default_gate_treatment: apply geopolitical/export gates where international, sanctions, nonproliferation, ownership, or export-finance conditions are material
risk_if_misclassified: geopolitical failure modes are converted into vague source-risk caveats

label: Public consent, challenge, scorecards, publication control, counterevidence, and redress
scope: public challenge paths, consent dockets, scorecards, publication redaction, grievance/redress, counterevidence closure, source authority
default_gate_treatment: apply where public legitimacy, sensitive publication, or counterevidence is an explicit control surface
risk_if_misclassified: public transparency becomes either ceremonial or unsafe
